items.title: Wires
items.description: FR, FR-LSH and LSOH house wiring in all standard sizes.

items.title: Cables
items.description: Flexible LT/HT cables, 0.50 to 1000 sq.mm class-5 copper.

items.title: Lights
items.description: COB spots, panels, street and flood lighting.

items.title: Servo stabilizers
items.description: Servo control voltage stabilizers for machines and retail.

items.description: 12 / 24 / 36 kV, 630 A, 25 kA outdoor LBS panels.

items.description: Centralized AC, chillers, VRF and cassette units for offices, hotels and retail.

items.description: Visi coolers, deep freezers, water coolers and ice-cube machines for retail & F&B.

items.title: CCTV

items.title: Fire alarm
items.description: Conventional/addressable panels, smoke & heat detectors, hooters, MCPs.

items.title: Fire fighting
items.description: Sprinkler systems, booster pumps, extinguishers and pump houses.

items.title: PA system
items.description: Public address for showrooms, malls, hotels, hospitals and industries.

items.title: Access control
items.description: Biometric & proximity access, attendance systems for offices and IT parks.

items.title: Home automation
items.description: Retrofit and centralized control of lighting, curtains, AC and appliances.

items.title: Home theater
items.description: Dolby Atmos rooms, 4K projection, acoustic design and multiroom audio.
